name: Sticky Mechanic
summary:
The Machine aches, its components weathered by time.

You'll help fix it, won't you? That's the job of a maintenance slime, after all.

Don't worry, Professor Palmer is here to help you. Together, you make an unstoppable maintenance team—but now, something is threatening your contented life together. Can your bond survive when the world beyond the walls of The Machine comes calling?

In this story-based platformer game, you take the role of the sole maintenance slime under the professor's guidance. Through a day-based gameplay loop, plan your route throughout The Machine to increase its stability as a story about ambition, purpose, and belonging unfolds. As the days count down and your farewell draws ever closer, the routine you share with the professor slowly becomes something neither of you want to lose.
